name: 037.5 — the close: the anchor as assertions, and what the example costs
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 037.5: the documentation's own claims about the grid anchor turned into checks (the anchor is the door from the live world into the database and round-trips through hafen.world exactly; a 64-bit id is a decimal string and a number is refused; a segment interns on the id it publishes; hafen.markers/hafen.radar and the live terrain reads on hafen.map are plain nil; marker:anchor() lands back on the tile the marker reports), plus the example addon's bill — with `atlas`'s panel on screen it runs 0 draw and 0 widget callbacks of its own, measured in the same sample as this suite drawing the identical picture from Lua and reading one a frame.
